$comment: Contract version of this payload. It travels in an envelope with protocolVersion 1 and changes only with it. Stable from 1.0.0-beta (docs/CONTRACTS.md).
title: Excubia exception batch
description: The exceptions payload of a push envelope with type exceptions (docs/push-schema.json, $defs.exceptionsEnvelope), sent by php artisan excubia:push-runtime to POST {appUrl}/api/exceptions when exceptions.enabled is true. One entry per occurrence group: occurrences with the same fingerprint, context and environment within the batch are merged. Groups are additive: the app adds count and widens firstSeen / lastSeen for the same fingerprint, also across batches. Masked before it is written to the local buffer; nothing else is sent: no request payloads, headers, cookies, users, IP addresses, stack arguments, local variables, .env values or absolute paths.

release.description: Optional (#129): the release when the batch was sent, one value for every entry of the batch. Release identifier of the deployed code: the release key of excubia.json, EXCUBIA_RELEASE, then GITHUB_SHA, CI_COMMIT_SHA, VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA, FORGE_DEPLOY_COMMIT or LARAVEL_CLOUD_COMMIT (no git fallback). Omitted when unknown. It is an extra dimension the app can group by, not part of the fingerprint.

className.description: Fully qualified class name. Anonymous classes are reported as Parent@anonymous, without their file path.

frame.description: One stack frame, innermost first: the file and line where the code ran and the function it ran in. Never arguments or local variables.

file.description: Path relative to the project root (vendor/<package>/... for dependencies), the bare file name for a file outside the project, null for internal frames. Never absolute.

function.description: Class::method or function name; {closure:...} without its line; null for the top-level script.

inApp.description: True for project code: inside the project root and not under vendor/.

fingerprint.description: sha256 of the class and the in-app frames as file|function lines, without line numbers (the top frame when there is no in-app frame). Stable across edits that only move code; the app groups issues by it.

message.description: Masked message, at most 1000 characters (a longer one is cut and ends with an ellipsis): emails, JWTs, bearer tokens, key=value secrets, API-key-like strings, UUIDs, long hex strings, phone-like and card-like numbers, numbers longer than four digits, IP addresses, URL credentials, hosts and query strings, host names in host: phrases, Authorization values of any scheme, quoted SQL literals and database host details are replaced by placeholders ([email], [jwt], [token], [masked], [uuid], [number], [ip], [host], ?[query]); absolute paths (also Windows and UNC) become relative or a file name, then exceptions.maskPatterns matches by [masked]. Query errors carry the SQL without bindings. The first occurrence's message is kept.

frames.description: The first occurrence's stack, innermost first, at most 50 frames.

previous.description: Classes of the previous exceptions in the chain, nearest first. No messages.

name.description: Route name (unnamed for a route without a name or a request without a matched route), job class, Artisan command name without arguments, or unknown.

environment.description: The Laravel environment (app.env), for example production.
